Why The Waverley

Why buyers start their search here

Downtown Ottawa runs on government, tech and universities — a tenant and buyer base that stays through every cycle. The Waverley puts you in the middle of it.

The Centretown address

428 Waverley Street, in the heart of Centretown — Elgin Street dining, the Rideau Canal pathways and the downtown office core are all an easy walk from your front door.

LRT at your door

Parliament Station on O-Train Line 1 is about a six-minute walk — one seat to the University of Ottawa, the Rideau Centre and Kanata-bound connections. Car-optional living, done right.

Live in it, or rent it out

Efficient 1-bedroom plans carry an accessible total price; 2–3 bedroom homes suit professionals and small families. Downtown Ottawa's rental demand — public servants, hospital and university staff — keeps vacancy low.

Built for Ottawa winters

Heated underground parking, a fully equipped fitness center that means no January commute to the gym, and a concierge-run lobby. Four seasons handled — so the building works as hard in February as it does in July.

FAQ

What buyers ask most

How does the deposit structure work?

Like most new-construction condos in Ontario, the deposit is staged rather than paid all at once — a portion on signing, with further installments at set intervals during construction and the balance handled at closing. The exact schedule for each release is in the price package; email us and we'll send it in writing, line by line.

What's included in the monthly condo fees?

Condo fees cover the amenities, concierge, building insurance, common-area utilities and the reserve fund. Heat and water are included in this project's projected fees; hydro is metered per suite. Projected per-square-foot figures for each layout are in the price package — no surprises after you move in.

When is occupancy, and what happens between now and then?

Occupancy is currently projected for 2028. Buyers receive construction updates as the tower rises, a pre-delivery inspection before moving in, and Tarion warranty coverage once they take possession. If the timeline matters to your plans — a lease ending, a relocation, a child's school year — tell us and we'll map it out with you.

Can I rent out my unit?

Yes — the building permits long-term rentals, and downtown Ottawa's tenant pool (public servants, hospital and university staff, young professionals) is one of the most stable in the country. If you're buying as an investment, ask us for current downtown rent comparables for the layout you're considering and run the numbers with real data.

Can I tour a model suite before deciding?

Absolutely. Call us to book a time — we'll walk you through the model suite, the amenity plans and the surrounding Centretown streets, and go through pricing and deposit schedules for the layouts on your shortlist. No pressure if you decide it's not for you.
